words.def: to think that something is true
to understand or become aware of something

to keep something in your mind, or bring it back into your mind
to ask yourself questions about something

steps.title: Check your own narrative. Did you do all four?
steps.model: Teller: I’ll never forget… · That reminds me of… · So then… · You’re not going to believe this, but… · In the end…

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ open a story so that people want the next line — I’ll never forget… / That reminds me of…
✓ signal the surprise before you deliver it — You’re not going to believe this, but…
✓ keep somebody else’s story going — Go on! / What happened next? / Really?
✓ react to good and bad news with the right phrase and the right voice
✓ use tell, remind, remember, recognize, realize without mixing them up
✓ write a narrative with a scene, a surprise and an ending recycled
